column1: # Deterministic measurements quoted in ../README.md, as the scripts printed them (2026-09-28).

# jit_heap.jl: minimum full-GC time after loading, and after the first inference
# bench_setup_micro.jl (indicative time; allocations exact): ns per node, min over 15 samples of 1000 nodes
